title: Trial and Compliance Standards Table — PAP Therapy Equipment
content:
# Trial and Compliance Standards — PAP Therapy Equipment

A coverage-billed PAP Therapy Equipment device runs a coverage trial counted in calendar days from the setup date as day 1. The table sets, for each device class, the trial length, how compliance is measured, the length of the consecutive usage window evaluated, the latest trial day on which the qualifying window may end, the minimum hours, the share of nights that must reach those hours, the trial days between which the practitioner re-evaluation must take place, whether compliance is proven only from modem or card data, and what a patient who fails the trial needs before a new trial can start.

| Device class | Trial (days) | Compliance basis | Window (nights) | Window ends no later than trial day | Minimum hours | Share of nights (percent) | Re-evaluation from trial day | Re-evaluation to trial day | Modem or card data only | After a failed trial |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Travel CPAP System (E0601) | 0 (no trial) | not applicable | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | no | not applicable |
| CPAP Fixed-Pressure System (E0601) | 90 | nights over threshold | 30 | 90 | 4 | 70 | 31 | 91 | yes | facility retest and visit |
| Auto-Adjusting CPAP System (E0601) | 90 | nights over threshold | 30 | 90 | 4 | 70 | 31 | 91 | yes | facility retest and visit |
| Bilevel PAP Spontaneous System (E0470) | 90 | average daily use | 30 | 90 | 4 | 0 | 61 | 91 | yes | facility retest and visit |
| Bilevel PAP Spontaneous-Timed System (E0471) | 90 | average daily use | 30 | 90 | 4 | 0 | 61 | 91 | yes | facility retest and visit |
| Adaptive Servo-Ventilation System (E0471) | 90 | average daily use | 30 | 90 | 4 | 0 | 61 | 91 | yes | facility retest and visit |

## The two compliance bases

- **Nights over threshold.** The minimum hours are hours of use per night, and the share of nights is the percentage of nights in the window that must reach them.
- **Average daily use.** The minimum hours are average hours of use per 24 hours across the window; no share of nights applies, which is why that column reads 0.

## Reading the table (hypothetical figures)

- On the CPAP Fixed-Pressure System (E0601), 21 nights of 4 hours or more in a 30-night window is 70 percent and reaches the share; 20 nights is about 66.7 percent and does not.
- On the Bilevel PAP Spontaneous System (E0470), an average of 4.0 hours per 24 hours reaches the minimum; 3.9 hours does not.
- With the setup date as day 1, trial day 31 is the thirty-first calendar day of the trial, and trial day 91 is the day after the 90-day trial's last day.
